text: ajay: dropping a quick Figma + playback of the new error drilldown pane — focus is on action ordering and export affordances. wondering if Export should be primary or tucked into the kebab. link: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/drilldown-v2 :eyes: kelly: watched it — my gut says Export is a secondary action. most users copy IDs or open the full trace. export feels heavyweight and rare. :thinking_face: maria: agree on frequency. infra teams hit Export for bulk analysis but product folks mostly use Copy ID / Open in logs. we should promote Copy trace ID and Copy correlation IDs first. ajay: good point. current layout we had: [Open] [Copy ID] [Export] — thinking to swap to [Open] [Copy IDs] (dropdown for which IDs) + kebab with Export, Permalink, Download JSON. tom: +1 for dropdown on Copy IDs. small keyboard-friendly menu would reduce micro-clicks. also needs visible success state for screen readers — not just a toast. kelly: accessibility note — when Copy happens, announce aria-live region text like: "Trace ID copied to clipboard". also aria-labels on the dropdown: `aria-label=\"Copy IDs menu\"` ajay: rough aria text I drafted for the copy button:```html Trace ID copied ``` sam: can we tweak the copy copy? end users don't always know what "trace ID" vs "request id" means. propose: button text "Copy trace & request IDs" and toast: "Trace and request IDs copied — paste into support tools" maria: prefer to keep button label short for visual density. maybe visible text "Copy IDs" and the aria-label expands: `aria-label=\"Copy trace id and request id to clipboard\"` kelly: visual ordering suggestion: left cluster = navigation actions (Open in Trace Viewer, Jump to Logs), middle cluster = quick copy buttons, right cluster = overflow kebab. Keeps primary flow centered. ajay: what about export variants — users expect CSV and full JSON. Should we show both directly or behind a modal? tom: modal is fine. but default should be CSV for stacktrace tables, JSON for the full request dump. show presets: "Export stack frames (CSV)" and "Export full event (JSON)". sam: one more copy nit: the kebab menu currently labels the item as "Download" — can we change to explicit verbs: "Export full event (JSON)", "Export stack frames (CSV)", "Get permalink" kelly: wording change approved from design POV. also add helper tooltip on hover for Export explaining what fields are included. small 2-line copy. ajay: accessibility bot run? @a11y-bot any red flags? a11y-bot: quick scan: focus order looks linear, but ensure the Copy IDs menu is reachable by keyboard (Enter to open, Arrow keys to select). Add tabindex=0 to the kebab trigger. Provide skip link for deep trace view: "Skip to trace content". Also ensure color contrast for the action icons meets 4.5:1. maria: noted. i'll file a tiny infra task: keep the copy action idempotent (if clipboard API blocked, fall back to selecting text and showing instructions). ajay: final ask — can design mock update with grouped clusters (nav | copy | kebab) + microcopy changes? kelly, can you drop updated frames by EOD? if so i'll ship to eng for slot next week. kelly: yep can do. i'll attach two variants: one with Export in kebab and one with Export as a tertiary button for customers on Dedicated. will include alt text and aria annotations. :white_check_mark: maria: i'll review and add keyboard behavior notes after your drop. tom: will check backend export formats and make sure endpoints map cleanly (CSV, JSON). sam: thanks team — small but high-impact. :tada:
